title: east-wrestling-1998-heavyweight
label: Mole

won.source: The promotion's own rebranded debut broadcast, whose closing line reads: "Ladies and Gentlemen, here is you EAST World Heavyweight Champion, MOLE!!!!!"

how: Awarded following a submission win over The Swinger; the broadcast's own text does not bill the match itself as a title match before the result, only the announcement afterward.
note: The vacant title's own first holder; no later reign survives in the held record.
